ownership.rationale: Links to the vendor-hosted theme gallery; Margin documents user themes instead.
Vendor-specific web destinations; Margin points at its own repo.
Proprietary third-party integration with an undocumented pasteboard protocol; command/PicGo uploaders cover the use case.
Commercial licensing is not a product feature; Margin is free.
Distribution concern, not editor behavior; Margin ships via its own release channel.
Privacy: Margin collects nothing; logging is local only.
Touch Bar hardware is discontinued and Tauri exposes no NSTouchBar API.
Version gates for platforms Margin does not target.
